messages:
opsbot: Pager triggered — gen-queue latency (eu-west-1) exceeded P1 threshold at 16:20 UTC. Alert: gen-queue-95p > 2.0s. Paging oncall.
jen_oncall: I'm on it, joining call. Can someone paste a short impact list so I can start a status draft? :phone:
maria_ops: Quick stats: 16:18->16:20 spike. 95p latency 2.1s (SLO 1.2s). Error rate flat ~0.2% (no spike). Affected route: POST /v1/generate (streaming). 3 customers seeing increased latency (acme.ai, synthio, finly). EU Dedicated tenants impacted + some hosted EU traffic.
jen_oncall: Thanks. Tom, any idea root cause? Anything to route traffic to fallback?
tom_sre: Looking. Initial suspicion: autoscaler thrash on the genpool causing frequent container restarts -> cold KV cache. Seeing scale-up events every ~30s for a subset of nodes.
jen_oncall: Can we patch autoscaler or switch routing to smaller model variant? Need quick mitigation and a short status message.
tom_sre: Pushing a temporary policy to prevent aggressive scale-down. Command I ran:
```bash
kubectl patch hpa genpool-eu -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```
Also enabling model-variant fallback on the routing tier for EU: routed live -> gen-compact if gen-large latency > 1.5s.
lucy_product: Draft for initial public status (short):
"We are investigating increased latency for text generation in the EU region. Some customers may experience slower responses. We have mitigations in progress and will provide updates every 10 minutes. No increase in error rates detected at this time."
jen_oncall: Shorten slightly for statuspage and add emoji:
:megaphone: "We’re investigating higher-than-normal latency for text generation in EU-west. Mitigations are underway. Some customers may see slower responses; no rise in errors detected. Updates every 10 minutes."
amy_legal: Quick check: wording fine. Avoid SLA commitments until we verify root cause. "Mitigations underway" is okay.
maria_ops: Published initial statuspage copy (internal draft posted to #incidents):
> :megaphone: We’re investigating higher-than-normal latency for text generation in EU-west. Mitigations are underway. Some customers may see slower responses; no rise in errors detected. Updates every 10 minutes.
jen_oncall: Thanks — I'm going to post the public update. Please add any customer-specific notes if you know a Dedicated tenant is hit.
maria_ops: Noted: acme.ai (dedicated EU cluster), synthio (hosted, heavy streaming), finly (dedicated, small bursty jobs). Ops contacts: acme-poc@, synthio-eng@.
jen_oncall: Posted to statuspage and sent a short customer-facing note via support copy. Tagging SRE to continue mitigation.
tom_sre: After the minReplicas patch + variant fallback, 95p latency dropped to ~1.3s at 16:28. Continued monitoring. Still seeing KV-warmup penalties for long tails.
lucy_product: Draft for 16:30 update (statuspage):
"Update: Mitigations (autoscaler stabilization + model fallback) implemented. 95th latency is improving but residual slow tails persist. We continue to monitor; no errors increase."
jen_oncall: Please keep the update concise. Also add an internal note for engineers about tracking regen-sla hits.
maria_ops: 16:32 posted update. Also added internal note: "Tracking regen-SLA notifications. Oncall will escalate if 95p > 1.5s for next 15m." :eyes:
tom_sre: Rolling a longer-term fix: adjust scale-down cooldown and add a warmup hook for KV cache. Patch queued to staging, will promote to prod once smoke checks pass.
amy_legal: Recommend holding off on any language about credits or SLA impacts until we confirm customer impact windows. Legal will prepare customer-ready wording if needed.
jen_oncall: 16:40 check-in: metrics show steady improvement. 95p ~1.1s now. Refs:
- genpool restarts normalized
- fallback routing handled ~12% of requests in worst minute
jen_oncall: I propose we prepare resolve copy but hold publish until root cause confirmed. Maria, can you prepare resolved draft with root cause summary and mitigation actions?
maria_ops: Draft resolved copy:
"Resolved: We identified an autoscaler configuration that caused frequent scale-downs in EU genpool, which led to increased cold-cache latency for streaming requests. We stabilized autoscaling and enabled a fallback model while a permanent cooldown and cache-warmup are deployed. No increase in error rates observed and impacted customers saw degraded latency for ~22 minutes."
lucy_product: Make the customer-facing line shorter: "Impact window ~22 minutes; temporary mitigations applied; permanent fix deploying."
jen_oncall: Agreed. Amy — legal OK?
amy_legal: Good to go. No SLA credit language. Keep timeframe and technical detail minimal for public notice.
jen_oncall: 16:54 publishing resolved notice now. Posted resolved status to statuspage and notified affected customers with the prepared copy. :white_check_mark:
maria_ops: Closing thread. Also filed a short post-incident note for the next oncall retro and linked the config diff.
tom_sre: Follow-up tasks: 1) promote cooldown change to prod 2) add warmup hook 3) add alert to detect autoscaler thrash. I'll open PRs.
jen_oncall: Thanks team. Marking incident resolved in pager system. :tada:
